mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates through yield-seeking behavior, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% triggers risk-off sentiment and central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recession fears dominate market psychology.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis recovery regimes, CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0% year-over-year signals strengthening economic activity and inflation expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During post-crisis recovery, when CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: New housing starts falling below 500.0 thousand units per month indicates housing market collapse, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500.0, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll employment declines (PAYEMS) signal deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales decline (RSAFS) and federal funds rate reduction (FEDFUNDS) indicate coordinated policy response to economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through recession pricing.
failure_condition: When RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS falls, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 (2017=100) indicates severe manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through deepening recession expectations.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90.0, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
